items.why: Crude futures are rallying on the oil surge flagged in CNBC's market live updates, which is also dragging the S&P 500 lower as traders watch yields.
Chip stocks are falling anyway despite TSMC's 55% revenue jump, as higher oil prices and elevated bond yields dominate investor attention, per Barron's.
A delayed EU vote on Full Self-Driving approval, pushed from October to December per Reuters, is weighing on the stock after three days of gains.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape as chip names slip on oil and yield pressure.

market_note: Futures pointed lower into the afternoon; crude futures are up more than 4%.
summary: Stocks are sagging midday as a surge in oil prices and elevated Treasury yields outweigh upbeat AI chip news. The major indices sit slightly red while the VIX ticks higher.
